title: Loose face/edge selection has no Metal mark
detail: Selection converts entities to group UIDs; Face/Edge have no matching resident placement UID. Compare also selected-edge.

title: Selection modifiers disagree with GL
detail: Shift/Ctrl/Shift+Ctrl semantics disagree; selection-modifiers.json proves state results.

title: Section Plane tool is inert; existing planes cannot be picked
detail: SectionPlaneTool is absent from dispatch. pick_section_plane returns None. Existing clipping/caps are implemented; do not rebuild them.

title: Tape cannot pick existing guides, axes or arbitrary edges
detail: All three methods return None. This blocks reference-based guide construction; Eraser also cannot pick a guide.

title: Whole-group Move ignores Ctrl-copy and bypasses array semantics
detail: Ctrl probe moves the original: two groups before and after, MoveGroupCommand, +2 m. Group move special path never forwards modifiers to MoveTool.

title: Window and crossing selection use the same visible-ID rectangle
detail: Both drag directions sort to identical pick_rect arguments; no containment test, no occluded entities, and no loose-entity box-selection resolution.

title: Imported image planes are absent and unpickable
detail: Magenta standing reference image exists in GL only. There is no image-plane stream or Metal image picker.

title: Material opacity is discarded outside X-ray
location: Python material ABI + Rust blend pass/shader
detail: Mirrored green glass is transparent in GL, opaque in Metal. Color alpha stores paint provenance; material opacity has no channel.

title: Translucent-tag opacity does not reach Metal
detail: Middle box on 25% opacity tag remains opaque. Toggle repacking is already fixed; the missing effect is opacity itself.

title: Billboard image export raises instead of returning an image
detail: Default and mesh-variant figure exports raise capture rows may only change visibility and tint. Billboard camera rotation changes temporary world matrices. Live figure rendering succeeds.

title: Show Hidden Geometry/Objects does not reproduce GL reveal
detail: Hidden face/edge reveal and stippled hidden-object box visible in GL are absent from Metal. Hidden faces are filtered in bake; no ghost pass.

title: Edit context is dark flat gray, without the GL edit box
detail: Metal replaces surroundings with (.35,.35,.35), regardless of GL fade amount/mode. GL washes toward background and draws a dashed edited-group enclosure.

title: Sun illumination and cast/ground shadows are missing
location: Rust shadow pass + Python sun payload
detail: GL shows shadows from all boxes/text on the ground. Metal has no sun/shadow-map/receiver path; AO is not a substitute.

title: Terrain, map tiles and photo mesh have no Metal draw path
location: Python scene inputs + Rust reference pass
detail: Pack enumerates only loose mesh and group placements. Geographic reference layers are separate GL passes. No geographic fixture was rendered; source-confirmed absence, not screenshot acceptance.

title: Soft cylinder edges reappear as internal profile lines
detail: GL suppresses vertical soft seams; Metal draws them with profiles enabled. Profiles-off pair isolates the reconstruction path. Corner normal smoothing itself exists in scene_bake.rs.

title: Locked-tag face fade is not reproduced
detail: Right-hand locked box is pale in GL and saturated yellow in Metal. Lock semantics must be retained while transferring layer_look fade to both face sides.

title: Export overlays argument is ignored
detail: Metal render_image never uses overlays and returns immediately after native image capture. Leader text/guides/plane widgets disappear; dimension handling needs matching export placement too.

title: Guides disappear when the document has no dimension/text
detail: draw_annotations is gated only by dimensions, text labels or active texture positioning. Section widgets alone do not enable annotation drawing.

title: Texture alpha is hard-thresholded, losing partial transparency
detail: Four alpha bands become binary opaque/absent. Preserve cutout treatment for foliage while supporting regular image alpha.

title: Group selection uses face stipple instead of GL group cue
detail: Selected red group receives blue face dots in Metal; GL highlights the group edges without that face fill. Review nested group bounding/enclosure treatment with G01.

title: Right-click does not resolve groups or locked context targets like GL
detail: Metal preselects only pick_face and omits GL _context_pick, locked_image and locked_group arguments. No popup was opened on the shared desktop.

title: Mesh previews are projected polygons; recessed faces stay visible
location: Python preview bridge + Rust transient pass
detail: set_suppressed_faces is a no-op. preview_faces become flat QPainter polygons, with no depth-tested mesh material/shading. Push/Pull and Follow Me need occlusion/recess acceptance.

title: Inference glyph shapes, size, halos and guide dashes differ
detail: Actual GL and Metal painter primitives: on_edge/component_origin/tangent become circles, intersection/center distinctions disappear, halo is absent, guide lines are solid. Axis snap gets an extra Metal marker.

title: Tool-owned overlays/lock labels are omitted by overlay scheduling
detail: Walk crosshair/Flip draw_overlay hooks run only through annotation callback; a plain document does not enable it. GL lock/reference/linear-mode labels have no equivalent calls.

title: Reference/tangent/nearby-edge inference has empty candidate paths
detail: Nearby loose/group edge methods return []; resident snap queries one picked row and does not supply scene guides/image borders. Endpoint/midpoint within a picked prototype is tested separately.

title: Selection and zoom rectangles lose direction/style cues
detail: Metal always uses an unfilled cyan rectangle; GL window is blue, crossing dashed green, zoom dashed orange with translucent fill. Compare box-crossing and zoom-window pairs.

title: X-ray color/overlap and hidden-edge look differs
detail: Metal is grayer and darker through overlaps than GL; this is a look mismatch, not proof that GL ordering is more correct.

title: Ambient occlusion is present but differs in contact darkness
detail: Both draw contact AO. The green glass box is incorrectly opaque before AO, so isolate opaque geometry before calibrating the effect. No foliage AO mask is carried by Metal.

title: MSAA edge rasterization remains visibly different
detail: At 1000×700 the large circular rim has more broken/dotted coverage in Metal. Both paths use their defaults; this is not a physical HiDPI validation.

title: Blue axis draws through the face-me figure
detail: Narrow remaining depth/order difference: vertical blue axis crosses the figure in Metal; GL figure covers it. Axis placement and billboard facing/UV are otherwise present.

title: High-resolution textures are resampled to a 1024 atlas cap
detail: Texture array scales every image to common width/height capped at 1024. GL _get_texture uploads the source image. Fine-detail difference is source-confirmed but no >1024 resolution chart was captured.
